summary: Add strict bidirectional local RFI/Submittal relationship questions backed only by explicit same-target relationship fields, plus shared direction and identifier grounding for model-generated answers and source findings.
decision_refs: The active objective requires efficient accurate adaptable questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
The existing question paths covered Email-workflow and workflow-file relationships but not direct RFI-to-Submittal relationships
Explicit labelled relationship fields are stronger evidence than document co-occurrence or workflow-index membership
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: The local shortcut accepts only strict English questions naming one exact target and the opposite workflow kind.
Only explicit Related RFI(s), RFI Reference(s), Linked RFI(s), Related Submittal(s), Submittal Reference(s) or Linked Submittal(s) fields under the exact target locator participate.
A value must be a bounded list of exact identifiers or one supported empty marker; arbitrary prose and ranges fail closed.
More than 32 primary files, candidate passages or relationship fields, more than eight distinct related identifiers, and conflicting empty/nonempty fields fail closed.
The implementation does not infer reciprocity, applicability, authority, chronology, precedence or contractual effect.
